# pve_firewall_alias (Resource)

Firewall alias (name to CIDR/IP mapping) at cluster, vm, or container scope.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "pve_firewall_alias" "example" {
  cidr  = "CHANGE_ME"
  name  = "CHANGE_ME"
  scope = "cluster"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `cidr` (String) Network/IP specification in CIDR format.
- `name` (String) Alias name.
- `scope` (String) One of: `cluster`, `vm`, `container`.

### Optional

- `comment` (String) <string>
- `node` (String) The cluster node name.
- `rename` (String) Rename an existing alias.
- `vmid` (Number) The (unique) ID of the VM.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Opaque identifier: scope/node/vmid/name (also the `terraform import` format).
